title: Tired of building alone. Anyone want to make a co-op game together?
author: keytonw
selftext:
I've been building with AI solo for a while and I'm kind of over working alone.

I'd like to put together a small team (3-5 of us) to make a co-op game, the kind you play with friends. I've got a few ideas but would rather we pick something we're all into.

We'll lean hard on AI for assets, so I'm mostly looking for people with taste and experience in what I don't have. Game dev, art direction, sound, marketing. Most important to me, though, is that you've been playing in this space (AI enabled game dev) a while and are interested in collaborating on something a bit more ambitious with like minded folks.

And, like everyone, I want supportive folks who will to tell me when I'm wrong and likewise accept constructive feedback. I already have a yes-man (Claude). :-)

We'd agree on a weekly time commitment and talk on Slack, with Zoom calls regularly. We deal with AIs all day, it'd be nice to see some actual faces.

It's unpaid and everyone brings their own tools. If it ever turns into something worth selling, I've set up LLCs before and can help with that. If it ends up being something just our friends play, that's fine too.

A bit about me so you know who you'd be talking to. I've spent 30ish years in software engineering and product management, mostly web apps. I've been CTO at a successful AI training company since GPT-4 came out, so I know my way around harnesses, agent workflows, working with teams,  and building/delivering production software. I have a day job, but I'm ready to put real time into a side project with the right people.

If that sounds good, DM me with what you do, something you've made, your timezone, and what kind of co-op game you'd want to make.
